title: COVID-19 Nasal Swab Trial
brief_summary: The purpose of this trial is to compare 2 types of nasonasopharyngeal swabs (a new design to a conventional nylon-flocked nasopharyngeal swab) for effectiveness.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years and older
* Ability to provide informed consent
* COVID-19 positive cohort only: a previous, positive COVID-19 test in the last 5 days and patient remains symptomatic

Exclusion criteria:

* Malformation of the base of the known skull
* Active nosebleed before the start of the sample
